messages:
Casey: Weekend question: rooftop BBQ Saturday evening with burgers & veggie skewers, or boardgame cafe downtown for dice-rolling chaos? Im torn. :meat_on_bone: :game_die:
Rina: Ooh tough. Rooftop if its clear, boardgames if youre feeling competitive. Ill bring coleslaw either way. :green_salad:
Mateo: I vote rooftop. I have a portable grill and a kebab inspiration spiral. Also will bring fancy hot sauce. :fire:
Linh: Boardgame cafe for me. My Catan streak must continue. Also the cafe has pie. :pie:
Priya: Can we try to settle with a tiny poll? Reply rooftop or cafe. Ill tally in 30 minutes.
Casey: rooftop
Rina: rooftop
Mateo: rooftop
Linh: cafe
Priya: cafe
Casey: Looks like rooftop wins 3-2. Plan: Casey's rooftop, Saturday 6pm. Bring layers and a lamp. If weather tanks we move to the cafe as backup.
calendar-bot: Event created by Casey: "Rooftop BBQ (backup: Boardgame Cafe)"  Saturday 18:00  Attendees: Casey, Rina, Mateo, Linh, Priya.
Linh: Backup plan acknowledged. If rooftop happens, I will bring that ridiculous salad with grapefruit. If cafe, I will bring a challenger (and my lucky dice).
Mateo: Grill check: propane full, tongs ready. Also will bring a portable speaker. Casey: any noise constraints?
Casey: Building says quiet after 10:30 but low-key music till then should be fine. If someone wants to crash overnight, I have an extra air mattress.
Rina: Bringing reusable plates and a tiny string of lights. This is becoming very cozy. 
Priya: Ill bring vegan burger patties and marshmallows. See you all at 6pm unless the sky looks angry. :cloud_with_lightning:
